test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following organisations is NOT related to the development of 'DIGIPIN', which was launched in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**DRDO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• DIGIPIN is a digital innovation launched in 2025 aiming to streamline digital identification processes in India.
 
• Organisations involved in the development of DIGIPIN include IIT Hyderabad, ISRO, and the Department of Posts.
 
• DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation) is primarily focused on defence technologies and is not related to DIGIPIN development.
 
• The initiative integrates advanced technologies like artificial intelligence and blockchain for secure digital identification.
 
• The Department of Posts plays a key role in ensuring nationwide accessibility of this innovation through its widespread network.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation)**

 
 
• Established in 1958, DRDO is India's premier agency for defence research and development.
 
• Its focus areas include missile systems, combat vehicles, electronic warfare, and aeronautics.
 
• DRDO's innovations like the Agni and BrahMos missiles have significantly strengthened India's defense capabilities.
 
 
 
• **ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation)**
 
 
• ISRO, founded in 1969, is India's national space agency responsible for space exploration and satellite development.
 
• Key achievements include the Chandrayaan missions, Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan), and the Gaganyaan human spaceflight program.
 
• ISRO's involvement in DIGIPIN highlights its contribution to technological advancements beyond space exploration.
 
 
 
• **IIT Hyderabad**
 
 
• IIT Hyderabad is a leading academic institution known for its innovation in technology and research.
 
• The institute actively collaborates with various organizations to develop cutting-edge solutions in fields like AI, blockchain, and quantum computing.
 
• Its contribution to DIGIPIN showcases its role in driving technological progress in India.
 
 
 
• **Department of Posts**
 
 
• India Post, under the Department of Posts, is one of the largest postal networks in the world.
 
• It has been pivotal in delivering government schemes and services to remote areas.
 
• Its involvement in DIGIPIN ensures accessibility and integration of digital identification across the nation.
